spellingPolicy: ASCII lowercase; US cozy and internationally used woolly; explicit variants
pronunciationScope: CMU American English; accent coverage is incomplete

measurements.note: Null means unmeasured, not zero. No familiarity or memorability score is invented.

confusionPolicy.spelling: Levenshtein distance <= 1 over canonical forms and explicit variants
confusionPolicy.sound: Minimum Levenshtein distance <= 1 over all pinned CMU phoneme sequences after removing stress digits
confusionPolicy.semantic: Explicit sets in curation.json; semanticFamily is an additional descriptive category, not measured confusion
confusionPolicy.interpretation: Screening features, not probabilities or a validated cognitive distance

statistics.note: Statistics describe the approved set; they are not human-performance measurements.
